# Api tokens (cms-admin)

<!-- module-flows:start (generated by .claude/bin/module-index; do not edit) -->

Flows: [`access-admin`](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md).

<!-- module-flows:end -->

## Purpose

Who may call the API with a key and what each key may do (D5, [access-admin flow](../../flows/access-admin/FLOW.md)). Admins see and manage their own tokens; the owner sees all.

## Techniques

A view (page) folder registered in `views/Views.registry.ts`; it reads data only through feature facades ([cms-admin rules](../../apps/cms-admin/RULES.md)). The scope is edited as a grid (content subject x action, with field pickers per type) and must stay a subset of the creator's permissions. The raw token is shown once after creation and the only way out is Done. Expiry is a local date turned into the end of that day.

## Technologies

React, TanStack Query, react-hook-form with Zod, `@abyss/form-commons`.

## Entry points

Route `/api-tokens`, page `ApiTokensPage`.

## Where to change what

Scope model rules: `TokenScope.rules.ts`; expiry dates: `TokenExpiry.rules.ts`; API error mapping of the form: `useTokenSubmit.ts`.
